02 / THE WALKTHROUGH

One idea. Three steps.

  1. 01

    Open the starter.

    Download and unzip the kit. Open space-explorer.html in a browser to try it. On a phone? Use the live demo.

  2. 02

    Give Kimi a direction.

    Copy the Space Explorer prompt below. Paste it into Kimi. To remix the starter, attach the HTML file or paste its contents.

  3. 03

    Run it. Change one thing.

    Save the HTML Kimi returns as index.html and open it in a browser. Try every control, then ask for one improvement at a time.

If the result breaks, paste the error back into Kimi and ask for the full corrected HTML file.

A couple of useful details.
Do I need to install anything?
The demo works in a modern browser. To work with files, a desktop or laptop is easiest. The prompts can be copied on a phone and used in Kimi. Kimi may ask you to sign in.
Is this the exact project from the ad?
This is a new starter project made for this guide, inspired by the ad’s Space Race theme. It is a small, working example for you to explore and customize.
Can I use the code in my own project?
Yes. The starter project and prompts are provided under the MIT license in the download and on GitHub. The orbital scene is a stylized illustration, not an astronomy simulation to scale.
